name: Stonewatch Tower
summary: Blackrock sentinels hold Stonewatch Tower in northeastern Redridge. Once Lakeshire's outpost, it now helps the clan watch the ridges and guard its mountain stronghold.

sections.title: A Fallen Watchpost
sections.body: Stonewatch Tower rises above Lake Everstill, guarding the high mountain passes. The Kingdom of Stormwind built it as a forward scout for Stonewatch Keep. From its heights, sentries watched the eastern ridges and warned Lakeshire of threats coming from the Burning Steppes. Warlord Gath'Ilzogg's Blackrock orcs swept down from the heights, overcame the human defenders, and seized the stronghold for their war effort. Blackrock sentinels now watch the tower, keeping Alliance scouts from reaching the fortress unnoticed.

faq.answer: Stonewatch Tower is a human watchtower within the larger Stonewatch complex in northeastern Redridge Mountains. Built to protect the region, it is now held by the Blackrock clan.

faq.q: Who controls Stonewatch Tower right now?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs serving Warlord Gath'Ilzogg control Stonewatch Tower. They captured the stronghold from Redridge's human defenders.

faq.q: Why is the tower important to the Blackrock orcs?
aliases: why do orcs want stonewatch tower
faq.answer: Its height lets the Blackrock clan spot approaching Alliance forces and guard the approach to Stonewatch Keep, their main fortress.
Lakeshire lacks the soldiers to retake Stonewatch alone. You can help weaken the Blackrock garrison holding the tower and keep.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you see how far the Blackrock clan has pushed into Stormwind territory while the kingdom's central army remains absent.
As a human from Lakeshire, you know the orcish standards above Stonewatch's towers threaten your people's survival.
